title: Replace the computer cooling fan: mount the computer case fan on its bracket and connect it to the fan controller
starting_state: Blue nitrile gloves, black computer case fan with unconnected fan cable, and black mounting bracket on desk. Screwdriver and two screws in yellow tool tray. Fan controller plugged into power strip, power strip switched on with switch lit. Blue taped square in middle of desk.

steps.instruction: Put on the blue nitrile gloves.
steps.completion_cue: both hands are in the blue nitrile gloves

steps.instruction: Place the computer case fan flat inside the blue taped square.
steps.completion_cue: the fan lies flat inside the square

steps.instruction: Take the screwdriver out of the yellow tool tray.
steps.completion_cue: the screwdriver is out of the yellow tray

steps.instruction: Install the black metal bracket. Set the mounting bracket on the fan so its holes line up with two opposite corner holes, and fasten it with the two screws.
steps.completion_cue: the bracket sits on the fan with both screws in

steps.instruction: Stand the fan upright on its bracket, next to the fan controller.
steps.completion_cue: the fan stands on its bracket beside the controller

steps.instruction: Connect the fan cable to the fan controller.
steps.completion_cue: the fan cable is plugged into the controller

steps.instruction: Switch the power strip on and check the fan.
Return the screwdriver to the tool tray.
steps.completion_cue: the screwdriver is back in the tray

hazard_rules.condition: worker is wearing blue nitrile gloves on both hands
hazard_rules.message: Put on blue nitrile gloves before touching the fan or tools.

hazard_rules.condition: power strip is switched off and its switch light is out
hazard_rules.message: Switch the power strip off before connecting the fan cable.
